name: welcome
speech: Welcome to the Smart Home Assessor. This tool will help guide you through the assessment process

items.name: kitchen
items.prompt: Is this a kitchen?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Walk to the kitchen.
items.output: You are in a kitchen.

items.name: kitchen_table_chairs
items.prompt: Is there a table with chairs?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards any table with chairs.
items.output: There is a table with chairs present.

items.name: kitchen_table_chairs_armrests
items.prompt: Do the chairs have armrests?  Answer with yes or no.
items.output: It is helpful for chairs to have arm rests at tables, to aid in getting up from them.

items.name: kitchen_dishwasher
items.prompt: Is there a dishwasher?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards any dishwasher.
items.output: There is a dishwasher present.

items.name: kitchen_cupboards
items.prompt: Are there cupboards present?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards any cupboards.
items.output: There are cupboards present.

items.name: kitchen_cupboards_height
items.prompt: AR_height_low
items.speech: Aim the phone so the floor and cupboards are visible.
items.output: AR

items.name: kitchen_cupboards_open
items.speech: Open up any upper cupboards so contents inside are visible.

items.name: kitchen_cupboards_heavy
items.prompt: Are there heavy items in the cupboard? Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards the inside of open cupboards.
items.output: It is better to put heavy objects in lower to reach spaces.

items.name: kitchen_fridge
items.prompt: Is there a fridge?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards any fridge.
items.output: There is a fridge present.

items.name: kitchen_fridge
items.speech: Ensure that you can reach to the back of your refridgerator and freezer.

items.name: kitchen_counters
items.prompt: Are there counters?  Answer with yes or no.
items.speech: Aim the phone towards any counters.
items.output: There are counters present.

items.name: living_room_cords
